Manifest.Name: 可能是成人用品/Probably Adult Goods
Manifest.Author: 不问世事
Manifest.Description: 新增「成人用品」品类：计生包装、各类玩具，以及对应的商人进货、拾荒和报纸行情。工坊包使用文字占位图。完整贴图另行分发，将 PNG 覆盖到本模组 Textures/Items/ 中同名文件即可。兼容游戏版本：0.46D / 1.0.0.6。Adds an Adult Goods category, with merchant stock, scavenging, and newspaper prices. The Workshop build uses text placeholders. Overwrite the matching PNGs in Textures/Items/ with the separate art pack. Supported game versions: 0.46D / 1.0.0.6.
